tool_args.rationale: The saturating pilot response is compatible with multiple mechanisms, while the bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest a coupled transfer process. A discriminating probe is needed before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit Beverton-Holt recruitment to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies only u_now, so it cannot distinguish recruitment saturation from a mobility bridge or identify dependence on the other inputs.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and more directly addresses the mechanism ambiguity.
It is not relevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
